MPS IIIA (Sanfilippo A) shares the pathway 'HS-GAG degradation' with MPS IIIC (Sanfilippo C) (similarity 0.58). It has natural history study 'Natural History Studies of Mucopolysaccharidosis III' (NCT02037880, sponsor Nationwide Children's Hospital). Ask whether its protocol, outcome measures or registry could be reused
